About.title: About Our School
About.description1: Dhanbari Collegiate Model School is a leading educational institution committed to providing holistic education that develops not just academic excellence but also character, leadership, and social responsibility. Since our establishment, we have been nurturing young minds to become responsible citizens and leaders.
About.description2: Our state-of-the-art facilities, experienced faculty, and student-centric approach ensure that every student reaches their full potential. We believe in creating an environment where learning is engaging, meaningful, and transformative.
About.highlight2: Comprehensive Curriculum with Modern Teaching Methods
